title: Command envelope definitions
description: The request and response fields every command in contracts/commands/ shares. The website try-it tools, Catch Host, the catch CLI and later WhatsApp send the same envelope to the same callable. Preview writes nothing durable; apply recomputes and refuses when the result changed since a confirmed preview; a repeated idempotency key replays its stored result.

mode.description: preview: work out and describe the result without durable writes. apply: make it.

idempotencyKey.description: Generated by the client once per intended action. The same key with a different request is refused.

surface.description: The client that sent the command. Recorded for attribution only; it never changes what the command does.

confirm.description: An explicit confirmation of one reviewed preview. Required for commands that message guests or move money; optional otherwise, and checked whenever it is sent.

summary.description: Plain-language description of what happened or would happen, shown as is on every surface.
